summary: Nine-metre bus-zone kerb on a main road with a house 11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 11 m from the kerb, others within 15 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is 9 m long, shorter than a van, on a through road with no parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Main road with a bus stop.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; signed as a bus zone.

flags: Low-lying: about 8 m, Sandy Creek 51 m away
sun_shade: Mixed; trees shade the road from the north and the kerb partly from the east.
